# CANDIDATE: ATR_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_VOLUME_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When volatility contracts tightly (ATR compression) for several bars, a subsequent breakout with a volume spike often initiates a sustained move. This edge exists because low volatility periods often precede explosive moves, and a volume spike confirms institutional participation.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If ATR(5) < ATR(20)*0.7 for three consecutive bars and then price exceeds the highest high of the prior 20 bars with volume >2× the average volume of those 20 bars, then enter long at the breakout bar’s close.
Exit shape: Initial stop at the lowest low of the prior 20 bars or at the low of the breakout bar; target at 2× risk or when price closes below the 20‑bar EMA; optionally trail runner with a premium‑stop of 20% of ATR.
